title: Freshman Induction Trail
description: Begin your journey as a newly admitted UoH student! Visit the Administration Building, check the Admission Office, and settle into your dorm room at MHK Hostel.

objectives.description: Visit the Administration Building (Building 36)
Locate the Admission Office (Building 37)
Check in to your dorm room at MHK Hostel (Building 13)

title: The Lakes & Dams of UoH
description: Discover all pristine lakes, reservoirs, and check dams across the campus sanctuary.

objectives.description: Discover Check Dam UoH (Pin 1)
Discover Amphi Lake (Pin 20)
Discover Secret Lake (Pin 22)
Discover Buffalo Lake (Pin 26)
Discover Peacock Lake (Pin 28)
Discover Auroya Dam (Pin 29)

title: Ancient Deccan Rock Explorer
description: Uncover the billion-year-old natural monolithic wonders and heritage rock formations of the campus.

objectives.description: Find the protected natural wonder The Masoom's Rock (Pin 27)
Climb up to Globbo Rock (Pin 17)
Reach the summit of Cherry Rock (Pin 24)
Explore the cavernous Aquarium Rock (Pin 25)

title: Academic Pioneer
description: Tour the prestigious schools of science, technology, arts, and literature across campus.

objectives.description: Visit Indira Gandhi Memorial Library (Building 51)
Visit School of Computer & Info Sciences (Building 45)
Visit School of Life Sciences Complex (Building 3)
Visit Centre for Integrated Studies (Building 5)
Visit SN School of Arts & Communication (Building 56)

title: The Scholar's Classroom Trial
description: Step inside a classroom in the Computer Science or Life Sciences department and pass the 5-question lecture quiz!

objectives.description: Complete a 5-question classroom quiz with passing score

title: Campus Sports Tour
description: Explore the athletic facilities and sporting courts across the campus.

objectives.description: Visit the Indoor Stadium and Gym (Building 30)
Check out the South Volleyball Court (Building 16)
Walk to the University Tennis Court (Building 63)

title: Night Owl's Chai & Beats
description: Experience UoH nocturnal life after 10:00 PM: order hot chai at Sukoon or South Canteen and check out the Amphitheatre scene.

objectives.description: Visit Sukoon Canteen (59) or South Complex (9) after 10:00 PM for late-night snacks
Participate in the Amphitheatre / South Complex night jam
